question.text: Anil wants to accumulate Rs.1 crore for retirement in 30 years. If he expects a return of 8% per annum, what is the approximate monthly investment required?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XVII p.26, accumulating Rs.1 crore in 30 years at 8% per annum requires a monthly saving of approximately Rs.6,700. Using PMT(8%/12, 360, 0, -10000000, 0) confirms this figure. The Trap: The other options (Rs.3,500, Rs.8,800, Rs.10,500) do not match the p.26 figure of Rs.6,700 for the 30-year, 8% scenario. Note: The figure Rs.6,700 per month is taken directly from the Series XVII workbook (p.26) illustration of accumulating Rs.1 crore over 30 years at 8%.
